themes_positive: turns around students who failed elsewhere
red_flags: Independent Google aggregate is only 3.0/5 over 12 reviews, well below the glowing tone of the older written reviews
Most substantive written reviews are 10-15 years old (2010-2014); little recent independent review text found
No klantenvertellen / verified-reviews page exists for this school
Quotes on the school's own website (Daphne, Diona, Jimmy, Zoe) are self-published testimonials, not independent
A defensive owner-style reply to an anonymous critical post appears in the third-party thread

review_summary: Independent written reviews (mostly 2010-2014 on autorijschooltarieven.nl) praise instructors Hans and Bart for clear, patient, humorous teaching, turning around students who had failed elsewhere and getting them through in one go; one genuine negative review complains the school never called back after repeated info requests, and the independent Google aggregate sits at a mediocre 3.0/5 over 12 reviews, so the overall picture is positive-but-mixed rather than uniformly glowing.
